scope: Independent source-only runner lifecycle, executed-byte provenance, CASE-first preparation, complete-call cache policy and terminal analyzer admission review. This review does not execute numerical kernels, builds, tests or timings.

closed_findings.evidence: Raw open and all three launches are inside try. Each owner is registered before Process.__init__, so partially initialized and earlier children are included in finally cleanup.
Each child and raw stream are closed independently with recorded cleanup errors; terminal state is saved before raw hashing and input postguards. Hash failures cannot produce success.
Every engine reuses freeze_executable with its qualified digest before Popen. The actual private executable copies are recorded in frozen_executables and input_sha256 and verified afterward.

The fixed deadline includes launch, numerical work, cleanup and postguards for admission. Numerical and cleanup elapsed times are retained; timeout, elapsed overrun or cleanup error disqualifies producer success. This review does not claim OS cleanup itself is instant at the deadline.

validate_terminal requires timing mode, completed status, no cleanup errors, deadline_exceeded exactly false, finite int/float durations and 0 <= numerical <= cleanup <= total <= 700. Its failure joins global_admission_errors and prevents any family from qualifying.

preserved_semantics: Exactly sixteen untimed CASE requests, each original coordinate immediately repeated, precede CONTROLS and match the original own exact snapshots.
The original response, reference, control, COLLIER pole and full before/after tensor/Laurent gates remain unchanged.
The same optimized binaries and per-engine cache policies remain in force; preparation and qualification occur outside acceptance intervals.
Shared positive iteration counts, ten warm calls, fixed fastest-engine calibration rule and all forty-eight balanced four-engine orders remain unchanged.
Every reported ratio has TIRust as numerator; no prior cohort is combined and no production adoption or speed claim follows from this source review.
limitations: Numerical preflight and timing still require ROOT authorization.
Independent parser/statistics and synthetic-control evidence are owned by the native owner and peer reviewer; this record makes no claim to have rerun them.
